subject: Operational proof for non-training processing + KMS/onshore routing questions
messages:
From: Claire Huang <claire.h@nebula-dx.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Ops Team <ops@nebula-dx.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proof of non-training + onshore KMS routing for pilot

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Legal has asked us for an operational pack demonstrating the no-training / no-model-improvement commitment for the pilot (Nebula Diagnostics). Specifically we need: 
- A short summary of how customer inputs are excluded from model update pipelines (operational steps),
- A subprocessor inventory and confirmation on where logs/prefixes might be stored, and
- Options for KMS routing so certain tenant data keys remain in-region/on-prem.

We are close on the SOW but procurement wants the DPA assurance before we sign. Can you send an evidence pack we can attach to our DPA review this week?

Appreciate it — Claire
Claire Huang
Senior Product Operations | Nebula Diagnostics

P.S. If you can include an estimate for time-to-deliver the pack, that helps our procurement timeline.

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire.h@nebula-dx.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proof of non-training + onshore KMS routing for pilot

Claire —

Thanks for the clear ask. We can deliver an Evidence Pack that covers operational controls, subprocessor inventory, and KMS routing options. High-level plan and ETA: 

1) Evidence summary PDF (controls + how we prevent customer data from entering model training pipelines) — draft in 48 hours.
2) Subprocessor inventory export and minimised scope CSV — 24 hours after the PDF.
3) Architecture diagram showing KMS routing, onshore key residency options, and recommended fallback (customer-managed keys vs Redwood-managed with onshore HSM) — 72 hours.

I attached a short summary (redwood_no_train_evidence_summary.pdf) and a routing diagram draft (kms-routing-diagram.png) to get the conversation started. Key points to highlight in procurement: 
- We implement capture tagging and ephemeral KV caches; only explicitly permitted telemetry is persisted beyond the request lifecycle.
- Model improvement pipelines are gated; customer-labeled "no-train" namespaces are excluded at ingestion and access-control layers.
- We provide both customer-managed KMS integration and an onshore-managed KMS option; we can show cryptographic key flow for either.

Kimberly / Marissa — can you confirm the latest subprocessor export (including cloud infra, telemetry provider, and monitoring vendor) and add it to the pack? Also FYI we may need a short statement from Legal about contractual enforcement language (DPA amendment suggestion).

Claire — happy to hop on a short call if procurement wants to walk the artifact rather than read it.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Head of Compliance Solutions (Redwood Inference)
[jonas@redwood.com]
[attachment: redwood_no_train_evidence_summary.pdf (pdf)]
[attachment: kms-routing-diagram.png (png)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 10:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proof of non-training + onshore KMS routing for pilot

Jonas / Marissa —

I exported the subprocessor inventory and reduced it to the fields procurement needs (name, role, region, contact, data access level). See attached stub; I will remove sensitive contact emails for the external pack. Notes: 
- Telemetry pipeline (SplunkOps) retains short-lived operational logs in us-west region for 7 days by default; we can configure a tenant-scoped export to an SFTP on Nebula's side if they require.
- Monitoring vendor (PulseWatch) has read-only access to aggregate metrics only, not raw prompt/response content.
- We will mark the inventory as "subject to DPA" and provide a redacted CSV for external use.

David — can you confirm the onshore HSM option timing? Claire asked for an ETA to include in their procurement schedule.

Kimberly Park
Director, Privacy Operations
Redwood Inference
[attachment: subprocessor-inventory-2027-06.csv (csv)]

From: David Kim <david@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Huang <claire.h@nebula-dx.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proof of non-training + onshore KMS routing for pilot

Jonas / Kimberly / Claire —

Quick timing update for procurement:
- Onshore-managed HSM (partner integration) can be stood up for tenant keys in ~3 weeks once we have PO + access windows; that includes key provisioning and audit verification.
- Customer-managed KMS (recommended for immediate pilot) only needs an IAM setup and a brief integration test (typically 3-5 business days). We will provide step-by-step docs and a test harness.

Action items for Claire / Nebula:
1) Confirm whether you prefer customer-managed KMS (faster) or want Redwood to provision an onshore HSM (longer lead, tighter audit).
2) Send any specific redaction constraints on the subprocessor CSV (we will redact contact emails by default).
3) If procurement prefers a narrated walkthrough, I can join a 30-minute call next week.

We will finalize the Evidence Pack (PDF + CSV + diagram) and upload to the Drive link in the next 48 hours once we have the redaction decision.

Thanks,
David Kim
Principal Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
